notes.title: Update #7 is LIVE - A Shocking New Experience
notes.notes:
Hello Club! We're bringing you our newest minigame (which is actually one of our oldest) and after lots of work finally has all the cool features we wanted!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676154/d3ae64b88d140b76619defb07338a7b78fa73ac2.gif

New Minigame: Tesla ReCoil - Originally built for the Global Game Jam in 2018, this game equips you with Chain Lightning powers to stop a robot onslaught. Fire your Tesla Charger - at your thrown Conduit Balls, robot enemies, and even parts of the environment - to get as many targets as you can in a single chain for massive combo points.

Minigame Improvements - Several minigames have been tweaked, and mechanics improved. Watch out for the crumbling handholds in Long Climb Home. 

Bug Fixes - Solved the mystery of the floating tomato, a UI bug in Challenges mode, as well as some water reflection issues.


As always, let us know if you have any questions, issues, or feedback. Sneak preview: At GGJ 2020 we made another great new game, and you'll see it very soon! Thanks again for supporting VR Party Club.

notes.title: Update #6 is LIVE - Wacky Moles and Improvements Across the "Board"
notes.notes:
Howdy, Club! In our latest update we "dug up" a new minigame, gave some much-needed love to our game boards, and more. Read on for details...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676154/b956b25cf799eb766d2baa23e975b39c0f51780d.gif


 New Minigame: Wacky Moles - Wield two comically floppy hammers and try to whack the moles invading your yard. Boop them hard on the top of their heads to earn extra points, and a platinum trophy could be yours!
 Board Feature: Avalanche - Mysterious "?" spaces have appeared on the Frozen Peak game board. Land on one to trigger an avalanche that pushes all players in its path down the mountain. If you just passed the mountaintop and earned your star, you'll love it - but if you were just a space or two away, get ready to climb all the way back up.
 Board Features: Pirate Cove - By far our biggest board, we have swapped one of your regular dice for the new Golden Die, which only contains values 4, 5, and 6. And, while you're zipping around the board faster than ever, take some time to notice graphical improvements to the ocean and sky surrounding this fantasy island.
 Board Feature: Winner's Crown - Show off your shiny golden crown when in first place, and don't let your friends dethrone you by getting more stars.
 Increased Number of Rounds - You can play a marathon session and test your endurance with the new cap of 15 Rounds per game.
 Bug Fixes - Path selection had an intermittent bug we squashed, and in the process made it all easier to chart a course to the Star Space. We also cleaned up some confusing minigame tutorials, for smooth and easy play.


We are so glad you're enjoying VR Party Club, and we're having just as much fun continuing to expand it on the path to release. Speaking of that, we know we're now beyond the originally projected Oct 2019 release date, but we think it's better to keep delivering an improved game over hitting an arbitrary deadline. That's why we're in Early Access - to ensure you get to enjoy VR Party Club every step of the way. Stay tuned for more info as we approach feature completeness, and a finalized release date, in the new year.

Let us know if you have any questions, issues, or feedback. Thank you all for your support, and we'll be back with another Update soon!

notes.title: Update #5 is LIVE - Now we're cooking!
notes.notes:
Hello Club! We're coming at you with a fresh new update hot off the grill. Enjoy a new minigame, and some new experimental gameplay modes. Check this tasty GIF and get the full details below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676154/1619c36a15d708d073b247cefa7cd81411d8650f.gif


 New Minigame: Order Up! - Become a grillmaster as you hustle feed burgers and fries to hungry customers. In this hellish kitchen you'll need to grill, stack toppings, and fry taters. Don't burn your burgers, and make sure you grab the right drink, as new orders keep rolling in.

 AI Opponents - No one to party with? Now you can add CPU opponents, and make the game more exciting. (Note: CPU opponents are not yet fully-featured, but they will improve over time!)

 New Mode: Challenges - We added an alternative to Practice Mode which strings together a few themed minigames. Challenge your friends or challenge your own high scores!

 Minigame Updates - Many minigames have gotten updates, so be on the lookout for some adorable new targets in Sweet Shot, and more manageable trophy scores.

 Bugfixes and Improvements - We fixed some wrong numbers on the game board, and polished a few rough edges in the experience. If you find anything amiss, please bring it to our attention.


In case you missed our previous Updates (which is likely when we can't keep up with Steam's announcement system!), check them out on our News page.

Let us know if you have any questions, issues, or feedback. Thank you all for your support, and we'll be back with another Update soon!

notes.title: Update #4 is LIVE: 2 New Minigames (And more)!
notes.notes:
Hello to the Party Club! We're happy to announce a new update with two brand spankin' new Minigames and much, much more.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/52067a1b9d3cfbef7b9036c7f6da11b49214863a.gif

Here's the full scoop:

 New Minigame: Disc Jamz - Jam out on our Vaporwave shores, catch and throw the disc into your opponents goal while protecting your own, if you can block and catch it you can fire off an electrifying Power Shot.
 New Minigame: Dungeon Dodge - Get ready to dodge, dip, dive, duck, and block the various saws, axes, spikes, arrows, and fireballs that aim to take you down in this perilous dungeon encounter.
 New Trophies: Get ready to test your skills for even greater rewards! Platinum trophies help you get an edge on the competition if you can show true mastery, while Tin will be there to catch your tears if you can't make the cut. 
 Big Wheel Improvements: We've taken a ton of feedback, and done extensive usability testing, and are tweaking the Big Wheel to make things feel just right.
 Board Update: New space icons for special spaces and a new space type to check out. In the Party Room, get your surprise gift box and grab a reward! New special spaces will be coming to each board, so be on the lookout for more to come!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/81025c626d7b30eed9c878c32d175b1baa097319.gif

As the title says, this is all live right now, so update and enjoy! Thanks for supporting VR Party Club as we're continuing to work on more features and content for you. Let us know any questions or issues you have, and we'll be bringing you another announcement sooner than later...

notes.title: Update #3 is LIVE
notes.notes:
Hello Club! We're delivering another awesome new minigame - and polishing the rest - in our 3rd content update for VR Party Club!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/684e4052a48f9a0f22496c368c55e401491421ac.gif

The main feature in this update is our 10th minigame: Beat Boxer! This is an active rhythm game where you must punch boxes coming toward you in time with a pumping track. Match blue and red gloves to the colored boxes (and hit purple blocks with either hand), and punch hard to get the maximum amount of points. Let us know how you like this new addition to the party!

Aside from that, we went through the other games and made some great quality improvements - better sound, camera angles, and more! Rounding it out, we have a couple bugfixes in the menus and minigames.

This isn't a huge update, but be sure to check out update #2 - from barely a week ago! - and enjoy all the new content we're bringing you. We're making VR Party Club the most accessible VR game, and the best game to share with your friends and family!

Let us know if you have any questions, issues, or feedback. Thank you so much for your support, and we'll see you for Update #4 soon!

notes.title: Update #2 is LIVE: Nuisance attacks, 2 more minigames, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello Club! We're so proud to announce that our second update to VR Party Club is live! We've been working on this, so I hope you're ready for a brand new party! Our goal is to make VRPC the most fun you can pack into one VR game, so we hope you like the new features!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/e8735da1c4dba7000f770f205bf4348b4ad6fd34.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/c834c2b347c62f99113b60cbdf2c4adc31634732.gif

Here's the full scoop:


 New Minigame: Long Climb Home - Ascend the mountain while avoiding rockslides, have a strong grip and a stronger will to make your way to the peak.
 New Minigame: Space Chase - Fire at the enemy frigate and dodge its energy blasts in hectic ship combat.
 New Mechanic: Nuisance Coins - Spend nuisance coins to pester your opponents with raining balls, splat their screens to blind them, or send in the swarm of angry bees. Watch your opponents carefully for the right time to strike and really trip them up.
 New Feature: Companion Webapp - Access the game from your phone or browser to use your nuisance coins, see your score, and check the game's progress. More features are coming in future updates too.
 Performance Optimization: Everywhere - We've gone over every game board and minigame to crank up your framerates and provide a buttery-smooth experience. Did we miss any? Let us know!
 New Title Screen - The title screen has been reworked into a real club with a hot new look.
 New Setting: Rounds - You can now adjust the number of rounds from 4 to 10, to support parties that last all night!
 New Ending Screen - Receive the proper fanfare for your efforts and find out who is the VIP of VR Party Club
 Minigame Improvements - We noticed some minigames were too easy and others too hard, so we adjusted scores for Silver and Gold ranks. We also fixed up some small bugs, and we hope everything feels even better than before!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/f3f7f5669e39e5ad6e0f29b2c2e07c703b861036.gif

As the title says, this is all live now, so update and enjoy! Thanks for supporting VR Party Club as we work to build more features and content for you. Let us know any questions or issues you have, and we'll bring you the next update soon!

notes.title: VRPC Update #1 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello Club! We're so proud to announce our first update to VR Party Club! We've been working on bringing you new features and content so I hope you're ready for a brand new party! Our goal is to make VRPC the best game for those new to VR and veterans, so we hope you'll like the new minigame, board game spaces for the Big Wheel, 1-Player Practice Mode, and more! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676154/5eee25827f96c9c5bdabe90351f3f95fb22c29e7.gif

Here's the full scoop:

 New Minigame: Cyber Shootout
Put your aim and quickdraw skills to the test in this sci-fi blaster showdown.
 New Board Space: Big Wheel
Land on the green space to test your luck on the Big Wheel - will you get free coins or stars, or steal them from your opponents? But watch out, because a bad spin could make you give away your stars or coins, or even trade them with your opponent!
 New Game Mode: Practice Mode
No one to party with? No problem! Challenge any of the minigames and hone your skills to prepare for your next VR Party!
 Performance Optimization: Everywhere
We've gone over every game board and minigame to crank up your framerates and provide a buttery-smooth experience. Did we miss any? Let us know!
 New Title Screen
The title screen has been refreshed, providing access to Practice Mode and 2-4 Player Party Mode on 3 Game Boards. Enjoy the fireworks!
 Minigame Improvements
We noticed some minigames were too easy and others too hard, so we adjusted scores for Silver and Gold ranks. We also fixed up some small bugs, and we hope everything feels even better than before!
 Board Improvements
When passing the Start space or Star space, you will now see the coins and stars you gain or lose fly into and out of your pieces. You'll see the same effects on the Big Wheel. And now the value of your roll will be clear no matter how far you throw the dice!


As the title says, this is all live right now, so update and enjoy! Thanks for supporting VR Party Club as we work to build more features and content for you. Let us know any questions or issues you have, and we'll bring you another update soon!
